title: GitHub Security Lab AI agent helps find code injection in cross-platform-actions workflow
summary: The release.yml workflow interpolates a user-controlled workflow-run branch name into a shell assignment in a privileged workflow_run context, creating an arbitrary code execution risk.
ai_role: GHSL credits CodeQL and its AI agent; the advisory was published 2025-10-27. It does not give a patch version or separate the tools’ contributions.
classification_note: The public advisory documents the vulnerability and disclosure/remediation status. It does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The cited public source does not establish a fix or fixed version.
